# Alex Leung

> Personal website and writing archive by Alex Leung, a software engineer, writer, and licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng.).

## Site Map

- [About](https://alexleung.ca/about/): Alex's background, previous work, education, and professional credential
- [Now](https://alexleung.ca/now/): a dated snapshot of Alex's current reading, goals, and interests
- [Blog](https://alexleung.ca/blog/): essays, technical notes, book notes, and personal reflections
- [Experiments](https://alexleung.ca/experimental/): browser-based tools for power systems, fractals, and control
- [Contact](https://alexleung.ca/contact/): ways to reach Alex and follow new writing

## Writing and Experiments

The blog covers software projects, AI tools and workflows, technical books, interactive experiments, and personal notes on moving, travel, study, and life outside work.

The experiments currently include an AC load flow solver, a Mandelbrot explorer, and a PID controller simulator. Each runs in the browser.

## Background

Alex's software work has spanned embedded systems, distributed systems, AI product development, and full-stack product engineering. His previous work includes home electrification, AR/AI hardware, and consumer finance.

He holds a Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Georgia Institute of Technology and a Bachelor of Applied Science in Electrical Engineering from the University of Waterloo. He is a licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) through Professional Engineers Ontario.
